test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

On cloud nine
solution:
The correct answer is “**To be extremely happy”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "on cloud nine" is a common phrase used to express a state of extreme happiness or euphoria. 
 
• The phrase does not relate to being cautious, shaky, or sad in any way, ruling out the other options as they do not align with the sentiment of elation.
 
• The imagery of being on "cloud nine" suggests a blissful, worry-free state that is visually represented by being elevated above the ordinary, every day concerns.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2’.**
